mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade_refund_log (refund_id, operator_id, action, content, create_time) VALUES (#{refundId}, #{operatorId}, #{action}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT log_id AS logId, refund_id AS refundId, operator_id AS operatorId, action, content, create_time AS createTime FROM trade_refund_log WHERE refund_id = #{refundId} ORDER BY create_time ASC, log_id ASC
